title: Clothes that fit, from tailors you can trust

cards.title: Made to fit you
cards.description: Every piece is made to your body, not a standard size. Measure once with your phone and use it for every order.

cards.title: Good tailors in one place
cards.description: Browse independent tailors and designers, see their work and prices, and pick the one you like.

cards.title: See it before you pay in full
cards.description: For custom outfits you see photos of the finished piece before it ships, and pay the rest only then.

cards.title: Covered if something goes wrong
cards.description: If your order is late, you get credit automatically. If it never ships, you get your money back.
